source_description: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, daily, 0.25 degree grid
accumulation_note: Accumulated fields (tp, e) carry GRIB step 5-6: a one-hour accumulation sampled once daily at 00:00 UTC. They are NOT daily totals and this file provides no way to derive one. Columns are named _hourly_ accordingly.

excluded_variables.sst: sea surface temperature is undefined over land
excluded_variables.swh: significant wave height is undefined over land
excluded_variables.mwd: mean wave direction is undefined over land
excluded_variables.mwp: mean wave period is undefined over land

gap_filling.note: No gaps present; no interpolation performed.
